productOverview.purpose: A local operator workbench in Visual Studio Code Insiders for mapping, governing, and validating agent surfaces before any live or production action.
productOverview.problemStatement: Cabina Universal has many capabilities, but day-to-day operation needs a visual local surface that shows what can run now, what is gated, and what evidence proves each decision.

projectType.technicalComplexity: Local files, VS Code Insiders extensions, dashboard evidence, validators, matrices
projectType.integrationComplexity: Local-only now; GitHub, OpenAI, Microsoft, Jira, and cloud lanes are gated by exact order

userPersonas.name: Operator
behaviors: Separates local work from live provider writes

functional.title: Canvas identity
functional.description: Root Agile Agent Canvas artifacts must identify Cabina Universal Agent Control and not demo project data.

functional.title: Governed VSI surface map
functional.description: Installed agent-like extensions and Agile Agent Canvas capabilities must be mapped to allowed actions, blocked actions, gates, owners, validators, rollback, and stop conditions.

functional.title: Local dashboard bridge
functional.description: The local agent bridge should expose the Agile Agent Canvas governance state and agent-control controls for operator review.

functional.title: Gate packet preparation
functional.description: Any Jira, OpenAI live, Microsoft live, Graph, Power Platform, production, remote mutation, or cost lane must stop at a prepared gate packet until target, owner, rollback, postcheck, evidence, and validator are present.

functional.title: Validator-backed closeout
functional.description: Every repo change must run relevant JSON, whitespace, dashboard, and governance validators before closeout.

nonFunctional.title: No secrets
nonFunctional.description: Canvas artifacts must not include tokens, keys, connection strings, cookies, private data, or broad regulated data.

nonFunctional.title: Reversible
nonFunctional.description: All versioned canvas changes must have explicit rollback through Git restore or commit revert.

nonFunctional.title: Local-first
nonFunctional.description: This lane may read local extension metadata and repo files, but must not call live providers or write outside the workspace without a governed order.

technical.title: JSON parseability
technical.description: All versioned Agile Agent Canvas JSON artifacts must parse with local PowerShell JSON validation.

technical.title: Allowlist staging
technical.description: Because the root allowlist ignores top-level folders, canvas artifacts must be staged explicitly with force only after review.

successCriteria.criterion: Root canvas artifacts parse and identify Cabina Universal Agent Control
No live provider write or secret handling occurs
Governance validators pass after explicit staging
